en: Mass-produced mass-produced MS, sortie.
From "Flash of Light Hathaway", the main MS Messer F02 type of the anti-Earth Federation government organization Mufti is commercialized in the HG series!
The model F02 that appears in the movie, such as the legs with "lifting flares", is recreated with new parts. A head part that can reproduce the commander aircraft is included.
● Thorough reproduction of Messer F02 type!
The leg shape of the F02 model with the added "lifting flare" is precisely reproduced with new parts. In addition to the left hand part in the open state,
A new head part that can reproduce the commander aircraft is included.
● A variety of action poses are possible with the movable gimmick.
The hover running state in the play can also be reproduced.
Attached weapons: Long beam rifle / Beam saber / Seal
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
